properties.name: phoenix.monitoring.docker-info.enable
properties.description: 缺省[是否采集docker信息，默认false].

properties.name: phoenix.monitoring.docker-info.rate
properties.description: 缺省[与服务端或者代理端发送docker信息的频率（秒），默认60秒，最小不能小于30秒].

properties.name: phoenix.monitoring.docker-info.host
properties.description: 缺省[被监控的docker主机，默认：tcp://localhost:2375].

properties.name: phoenix.monitoring.docker-info.tls-verify
properties.description: 缺省[启用/禁用TLS验证，默认false].

properties.name: phoenix.monitoring.docker-info.cert-path
properties.description: 缺省[验证所需证书的路径，默认：不填写].

properties.name: phoenix.monitoring.docker-info.config
properties.description: 缺省[其他docker配置文件的路径，默认：不填写].

properties.name: phoenix.monitoring.docker-info.registry-url
properties.description: 缺省[注册地址，默认：不填写].

properties.name: phoenix.monitoring.docker-info.registry-username
properties.description: 缺省[注册用户名，默认：不填写].

properties.name: phoenix.monitoring.docker-info.registry-password
properties.description: 缺省[注册密码，默认：不填写].

properties.name: phoenix.monitoring.docker-info.registry-email
properties.description: 缺省[注册电子邮箱，默认：不填写].
